title: UFO sample receipt v1
description: One `ufo sample` run: the synthetic case folder it wrote, and every file in it with its size and SHA-256. The verb reads no input and no clock, so two runs write the same bytes; the case is built in a private staging directory and moved into place under a contract that cannot replace anything, so a destination that already exists is refused and nothing is ever overwritten. The published `MANIFEST.json` names, per file, what was planted and which inspection flags and findings it is expected to raise.

note.description: The standing statement that every name, number and address in the case is invented.

manifest.description: The file inside the case that says what is planted in each of the others.

path.description: The directory the case was published to. On a refusal nothing was written there.

files.description: Every published file, relative to the case directory, hashed after publication. Empty unless the status is completed.

license.description: The licence this run was under: tier free and verified false when no licence file applied. Optional, so a receipt from a build older than the licence file still validates. It records a fact about the run and never marks, degrades or qualifies the work the receipt describes.
